summary: Implemented the Lambda and Lambdad transforms as specified, without running any code or tests (per instructions). Changes: (1) monai/transforms/utility/array.py: Lambda class appended at end, asserting callable(func) with message "func must be callable", __call__ returns func(img). (2) monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: Callable added to typing import, Lambda imported from array module, Lambdad(MapTransform) added after ConcatItemsd (calls MapTransform base first, then builds one internal Lambda; __call__ shallow-copies with copy.copy and applies the internal Lambda to each configured key), and LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended to the alias block. (3) docs/source/transforms.rst: Lambda entry before SplitChannel in Vanilla Transforms; Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd in Dictionary-based Transforms. (4) tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py added, covering identity and slicing callables (Lambdad uses a dict_keys view) and the alias identity. Tests have not been run. No commits were made. Choices: copy.copy for the shallow copy; single-key example in Lambdad docstring; ellipsis slicing in tests for the 4-D test image.
